text:
Eli J.: Heads-up — onboarding keeps tripping over the Go generator sample. Canceling the parent ctx mid-stream sometimes leaves reader goroutines stuck. Minimal repro: start generator, read one token, cancel ctx; Next() can block for the entire server response.

Eli J.: Snippet we gave support:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
iter, _ := client.Generator(ctx, req)
_, _ = iter.Next() // read first token
cancel()
// Next() may hang
```

Rina C.: Which transport in the sample app?

Eli J.: net/http. Looks like auth-refresh / retry logic at transport layer races with cancel and reopens the stream; old read goroutine stays blocked on Read().

Vikram S.: This is an ergonomics + parity issue. Node/py abort streams on cancel. For Go we never added a clean Close() on the iterator. Two-prong fix: API change + transport guard.

Rina C.: Proposal: make iterator implement io.Closer: Close() cancels internal request context, drains/close body, and causes in-flight Next() to return context.Canceled. Add unit tests to assert fast return after Close().

Vikram S.: Transport change: add per-call option NoStreamRetry (default true for streaming calls). Transport must not attempt auth-retry for streams; unary retry behavior stays the same. That prevents the reopen-race.

Eli J.: Short term: update sample app to call `defer iter.Close()` and show read loop pattern that selects on ctx.Done() and calls iter.Close(). Quickstart note too.

docops: Agreed. I'll add a small Quickstart blurb and example snippet showing both patterns (`defer iter.Close()` and `select { case <-ctx.Done(): iter.Close(); return }`).

ci-bot: Please also add a regression test: snapshot runtime.NumGoroutine() before/after Close() with a short timeout, fail if delta > 2.

Rina C.: I'll own the iterator API change + tests. Plan: add Close(), map canceled state -> context.Canceled, and keep Next() signature to minimize churn. Consider adding `NextWithCtx(ctx)` as an opt-in follow-up if folks want per-call cancels.

Vikram S.: I'll change transport to respect NoStreamRetry meta and add tests for the 401 refresh race. We'll start with NoStreamRetry true by default for streaming endpoints.

Eli J.: I'll update the sample app PR and the onboarding note. Once Rina's tests land we can add the CI goroutine leak check to the pipeline.

docops: After landing, I’ll update Quickstart and add a short troubleshooting FAQ entry.

Vikram S.: Also captured a follow-up: expose buffer/backpressure option (BufferTokens) to bound in-memory queues inside iterator so cancelled apps don't retain large buffers. Filed follow-up issue.

Eli J.: Thanks — this should cut support noise. Posting issue/PR links once ready. :raised_hands:
